healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the Apollo connector. Calls GET /api/v1/auth/health and returns status ok plus the Apollo payload. HTTP 200 is accepted even when is_logged_in is false, because a declarative body error path cannot treat boolean false as a failure.

data.description: Apollo auth health payload. HTTP 200 is accepted even when is_logged_in is false.

people.search.title: Search People
people.search.description: Search for prospect candidates in Apollo using keywords, titles, seniorities, locations, and organization criteria. Search results are sparse and may include email availability indicators but do not include email addresses or phone numbers; use people.match to enrich contact details.

q_keywords.description: Optional. Keywords to search for across all person fields.

person_titles.description: Optional. List of job titles to filter by (e.g. ["VP of Sales", "Director of Marketing"]).

person_seniorities.description: Optional. Seniority levels to filter by (e.g. ["senior", "director", "vp", "c_suite"]).

person_locations.description: Optional. Geographic locations to filter by (e.g. ["United States", "New York, NY"]).

organization_domains.description: Optional. Company domains to filter by (e.g. ["google.com", "salesforce.com"]). Sent as q_organization_domains_list[], Apollo's query name for this filter.

organization_num_employees_ranges.description: Optional. Employee count ranges to filter by (e.g. ["1,10", "11,50", "51,200"]).

per_page.description: Optional. Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100).

q_person_name.description: Optional. Person name to match independently of other filters.

include_similar_titles.description: Optional. When false, person_titles[] matches titles strictly.

organization_locations.description: Optional. Headquarters locations of the person's current employer.

organization_ids.description: Optional. Apollo organization IDs to include.

contact_email_status.description: Optional. Email statuses such as verified, unverified, likely to engage, or unavailable.

data.description: Apollo people search payload, including people and pagination.

total_entries.description: Optional total number of matching candidates reported by Apollo.

people.match.title: Match Person
people.match.description: Find a specific person in Apollo by matching on name, email, domain, organization, or LinkedIn URL. Returns enriched person data including contact information.

id.description: Optional. Apollo person ID. The most reliable way to enrich a known prospect — supply this to bypass fuzzy matching entirely.

domain.description: Optional. Company domain to narrow the match (e.g. "google.com").

organization_name.description: Optional. Company name to narrow the match.

linkedin_url.description: Optional. LinkedIn profile URL of the person.

reveal_personal_emails.description: Optional. Whether to attempt to reveal personal email addresses (uses credits).

reveal_phone_number.description: Optional. Whether to attempt to reveal phone numbers (uses credits). Apollo requires webhook_url when this is true. The number arrives asynchronously and is ingested as webhook.phone_revealed.

webhook_url.description: Optional. Public URL Apollo calls when reveal_phone_number is true. A caller-supplied webhook_url is forwarded. Apollo requires it for phone reveal. Phone results arrive asynchronously and are ingested as webhook.phone_revealed.

people.bulk_match.title: Bulk Match People
people.bulk_match.description: Match multiple people at once by providing a list of person detail objects. Each object can include first_name, last_name, email, domain, organization_name, or linkedin_url.

details.description: Array of person detail objects to match against Apollo database.

reveal_personal_emails.description: Optional. Reveal personal emails. Uses credits.

reveal_phone_number.description: Optional. Reveal phone numbers. Requires webhook_url.

webhook_url.description: Optional. Public URL for asynchronous phone reveal. Forwarded when provided. Required by Apollo when reveal_phone_number is true.

organizations.search.title: Search Organizations
organizations.search.description: Search for companies/organizations in Apollo by name, location, and employee count ranges.

q_organization_name.description: Optional. Company name keyword to search for.

organization_locations.description: Optional. List of geographic locations to filter by (e.g. ["United States", "San Francisco, CA"]).

organization_num_employees_ranges.description: Optional. Employee count ranges to filter by (e.g. ["1,10", "11,50"]).

per_page.description: Optional. Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100).

organization_ids.description: Optional. Apollo organization IDs to include.

q_organization_domains_list.description: Optional. Company domains to include, without www or protocol.

q_organization_keyword_tags.description: Optional. Keyword tags associated with the organizations.

organizations.enrich.title: Enrich Organization
organizations.enrich.description: Retrieve detailed company/organization information from Apollo by providing a company domain name. Returns firmographic data, technographics, and social profiles.

organizations.bulk_enrich.title: Bulk Enrich Organizations
organizations.bulk_enrich.description: Enrich multiple organizations at once by providing a list of company domains. Returns firmographic and enrichment data for each domain.

domains.description: List of company domains to enrich (e.g. ["apollo.io", "google.com"]).

details.description: Optional organization detail objects. When present, Apollo prefers details over domains[].

organizations.job_postings.title: Get Organization Job Postings
organizations.job_postings.description: Retrieve open job postings for a specific organization in Apollo by its organization ID. Useful for understanding company growth signals.

id.description: The Apollo organization ID to get job postings for.

contacts.create.title: Create Contact
contacts.create.description: Create a new contact record in Apollo CRM with full profile details including name, email, phone, title, and company information.

organization_name.description: Optional. Company name for the contact.

label_names.description: Optional. List of label names to apply to the contact.

account_id.description: Optional. Apollo account ID to link.

present_raw_address.description: Optional. Current location as a single string.

typed_custom_fields.description: Optional. Typed custom field values keyed by Apollo field ID.

run_dedupe.description: Optional. When true, Apollo deduplicates against existing contacts.

contacts.update.title: Update Contact
contacts.update.description: Update an existing contact record in Apollo CRM by its ID. Provide only the fields you want to change.

id.description: The Apollo contact ID to update.

label_names.description: Optional. Updated list of label names.

account_id.description: Optional. Apollo account ID to link.

present_raw_address.description: Optional. Current location as a single string.

typed_custom_fields.description: Optional. Typed custom field values keyed by Apollo field ID.

contacts.search.title: Search Contacts
contacts.search.description: Search contacts in your Apollo CRM database using various filters including name, email, title, and more.

q_keywords.description: Optional. Keywords to search across contact fields.

per_page.description: Optional. Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100).

contact_stage_ids.description: Optional. Contact stage IDs to include.

contact_label_ids.description: Optional. Contact label IDs to include.

sort_by_field.description: Optional. Field used to sort the results.

accounts.create.title: Create Account
accounts.create.description: Create a new account (company) record in Apollo CRM with company name, domain, and other firmographic details.

label_names.description: Optional. List of label names to apply to the account.

phone.description: Optional. Primary phone. Apollo's create-account field name.

owner_id.description: Optional. Apollo user ID that owns the account.

typed_custom_fields.description: Optional. Typed custom field values keyed by Apollo field ID.

accounts.update.title: Update Account
accounts.update.description: Update an existing account (company) record in Apollo CRM by its ID. Provide only the fields you want to change.

id.description: The Apollo account ID to update.

phone.description: Optional. Updated primary phone. Apollo's update-account field name.

owner_id.description: Optional. Updated Apollo owner user ID.

account_stage_id.description: Optional. Updated Apollo account stage ID.

typed_custom_fields.description: Optional. Typed custom field values keyed by Apollo field ID.

sequences.search.title: Search Sequences
sequences.search.description: Search for email sequences (emailer campaigns) in Apollo. Returns sequences with their status, steps, and settings.

q_keywords.description: Optional. Keywords to search sequences by name.

per_page.description: Optional. Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100).

q_name.description: Optional. Sequence name query. Sent as q_name.

sequences.add_contacts.title: Add Contacts to Sequence
sequences.add_contacts.description: Add one or more contacts to an Apollo email sequence (emailer campaign) by providing their contact IDs and optionally the sending email account.

emailer_campaign_id.description: The Apollo sequence/emailer campaign ID to add contacts to.

contact_ids.description: List of contact IDs to add to the sequence.

send_email_from_email_account_id.description: Apollo email account ID used to send sequence email. Required by the add-contacts endpoint.

label_names.description: Optional. Label names whose contacts are added when contact_ids is also sent.

send_email_from_email_address.description: Optional. Specific mailbox address inside the email account.

sequence_no_email.description: Optional. Add contacts that have no email address.

sequence_unverified_email.description: Optional. Add contacts with an unverified email address.

sequence_job_change.description: Optional. Add contacts who recently changed jobs.

sequence_active_in_other_campaigns.description: Optional. Add contacts already active in other sequences.

sequence_finished_in_other_campaigns.description: Optional. Add contacts finished in other sequences.

sequence_same_company_in_same_campaign.description: Optional. Add contacts when the same company is already in this sequence.

contacts_without_ownership_permission.description: Optional. Add contacts without ownership permission.

user_id.description: Optional. Apollo user ID recorded as the actor.

status.description: Optional initial status for the added contacts.

auto_unpause_at.description: Optional. ISO 8601 time to unpause contacts when status is paused.

email_accounts.list.title: List Email Accounts
email_accounts.list.description: Retrieve all email accounts connected to Apollo for sending sequences. Returns account details including email address and sending limits.

users.search.title: Search Users
users.search.description: Search for users in your Apollo organization. Returns user profiles including name, email, role, and permissions.

q_keywords.description: Optional. Keywords to search user names or emails.

per_page.description: Optional. Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100).

accounts.search.title: Search Accounts
accounts.search.description: Search Apollo CRM accounts by organization name and account stage.

accounts.get.title: Get Account
accounts.get.description: Retrieve one Apollo CRM account by its account ID.

contacts.get.title: Get Contact
contacts.get.description: Retrieve one Apollo CRM contact by its contact ID.

contacts.update_stage.title: Update Contact Stage
contacts.update_stage.description: Set the Apollo stage for one or more contacts.

contact_stage_id.description: Apollo contact stage ID to apply.

deals.list.title: List Deals
deals.list.description: List Apollo deals (opportunities) with optional pagination and sorting.

sort_by_field.description: Optional Apollo deal field to sort by.

deals.get.title: Get Deal
deals.get.description: Retrieve one Apollo deal (opportunity) by its ID.

deals.create.title: Create Deal
deals.create.description: Create an Apollo deal with its name and optional owner, account, stage, amount, and close date.

owner_id.description: Optional Apollo user ID for the deal owner.

account_id.description: Optional Apollo account ID associated with the deal.

amount.description: Optional decimal deal amount as a string, preserving fractional currency values.

closed_date.description: Optional expected or actual close date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

deals.update.title: Update Deal
deals.update.description: Update an Apollo deal by its opportunity ID; provide any documented mutable deal fields.

name.description: Updated deal name; required as a non-empty update field.

owner_id.description: Optional Apollo user ID for the deal owner.

account_id.description: Optional Apollo account ID associated with the deal.

amount.description: Optional decimal deal amount as a string, preserving fractional currency values.

closed_date.description: Optional close date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

tasks.search.title: Search Tasks
tasks.search.description: Search Apollo tasks with optional pagination and sort field.

sort_by_field.description: Optional Apollo task field to sort by.

tasks.get.title: Get Task
tasks.get.description: Retrieve one Apollo task by its ID.

tasks.create.title: Create Task
tasks.create.description: Create an Apollo task for a user and contact with a type, status, and due time.

user_id.description: Apollo user ID assigned to the task.

contact_id.description: Apollo contact ID related to the task.

type.description: Apollo task type: call, outreach_manual_email, linkedin_step_connect, linkedin_step_message, linkedin_step_view_profile, linkedin_step_interact_post, or action_item.

status.description: Initial task status: scheduled, completed, or skipped.

due_at.description: Task due time in ISO-8601 form.

priority.description: Apollo task priority: high, medium, or low.

tasks.update.title: Update Task
tasks.update.description: Update an Apollo task. Supply its current creator ID and priority because Apollo resets omitted values on scheduled tasks.

creator_id.description: Current task creator ID; echo the value from Get Task.

priority.description: Apollo task priority: high, medium, or low.

type.description: Apollo task type: call, outreach_manual_email, linkedin_step_connect, linkedin_step_message, linkedin_step_view_profile, linkedin_step_interact_post, or action_item.

status.description: Only scheduled is supported here. Use Apollo complete or skip endpoints to finish a task.

due_at.description: Optional updated due time in ISO-8601 form.

sequences.activate.title: Activate Sequence
sequences.activate.description: Activate an inactive Apollo sequence so scheduled outreach can send. The sequence must contain at least one step.

sequence_id.description: Apollo ID of the inactive sequence to activate.

sequences.deactivate.title: Deactivate Sequence
sequences.deactivate.description: Deactivate an active Apollo sequence, pausing enrolled contacts and stopping scheduled email sends.

sequence_id.description: Apollo ID of the active sequence to deactivate.

sequences.archive.title: Archive Sequence
sequences.archive.description: Archive an Apollo sequence, marking it inactive and finishing currently enrolled contacts. The caller must own the sequence or have full-access sharing permission.

sequence_id.description: Apollo ID of the sequence to archive.

accounts.update_stage.title: Bulk Update Account Stage
accounts.update_stage.description: Move one or more existing Apollo accounts to the same account stage.

account_stage_id.description: Apollo account stage ID to apply.

tasks.complete.title: Complete Task
tasks.complete.description: Permanently mark an Apollo task completed. Apollo has no undo or reopen route. Completing an already completed or skipped task returns 422.

note.description: Optional note recorded when completing the task.

accounts.bulk_create.title: Bulk Create Accounts
accounts.bulk_create.description: Create up to 100 Apollo accounts in one request. Existing matches are returned without modification.

accounts.description: Account objects to create, maximum 100. Each should include a name or domain.

domain.description: Company domain without www, for example acme.com.

owner_id.description: Apollo user ID assigned as account owner.

typed_custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field ID.

run_dedupe.description: When true, also match existing accounts by domain, organization_id, and name.

append_label_names.description: List names to add to every account in this request.

contacts.bulk_create.title: Bulk Create Contacts
contacts.bulk_create.description: Create up to 100 Apollo contacts in one request with optional deduplication.

typed_custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field ID.

run_dedupe.description: When true, return existing contacts that match instead of creating duplicates.

owner_id.description: Optional owner applied to created contacts.

append_label_names.description: List names to add to every contact in this request.

calls.create.title: Create Call Record
calls.create.description: Log an externally made phone call in Apollo. This does not dial a prospect.

note.description: Note stored on the call record.

logged.description: When true, create an individual Apollo phone-call record.

user_id.description: Apollo user IDs for the caller.

duration.description: Call duration in seconds, not minutes.

end_time.description: Call end time in ISO-8601 GMT.

start_time.description: Call start time in ISO-8601 GMT.

custom_fields.create.title: Create Custom Field
custom_fields.create.description: Create a typed custom field for Apollo contacts, accounts, or opportunities.

label.description: Display name for the custom field.

modality.description: Object type the field applies to.

emails.create_draft.title: Create Email Draft
emails.create_draft.description: Create an unsent Apollo outreach draft, or return the draft already linked to outreach_task_id. Provide contact_id, or in_response_to_emailer_message_id to reply in an existing thread.

contact_id.description: Apollo contact ID that receives the draft, required unless replying to an existing message.

body_html.description: HTML body. Apollo sanitizes it before saving.

contact_id.description: Apollo contact ID for the recipient.

recipient_type_cd.description: Recipient role such as to, cc, or bcc.

enable_tracking.description: Whether to enable permitted open and click tracking.

outreach_task_id.description: Outreach task ID to associate. If that task already has a draft, Apollo returns it.

in_response_to_emailer_message_id.description: Parent email ID when drafting a reply.

sequences.create.title: Create Sequence
sequences.create.description: Create an Apollo outreach sequence, optionally including steps and email variants.

active.description: When true, activate the sequence immediately.

folder_id.description: Apollo folder ID for the sequence.

label_names.description: List names to apply. Apollo creates missing labels.

emailer_steps.description: Ordered sequence steps and their touches.

id.description: Existing step ID when updating a sequence.

wait_time.description: Wait amount after the previous step.

exact_datetime.description: Exact ISO-8601 datetime when sequence_by_exact_daytime is true.

auto_skip_in_x_days.description: Skip the step task after this many days.

emailer_touches.description: Email or task variants for the step.

items.description: Email or task variant for a sequence step.

status.description: Touch approval status, for example approved.

id.description: Existing touch ID when updating a sequence.

mark_paused_if_ooo.description: Pause a contact when an out-of-office reply is detected.

max_emails_per_day.description: Maximum emails this sequence sends per day.

emailer_schedule_id.description: Non-empty team schedule ID controlling send days and times.

sequence_ruleset_id.description: Existing ruleset ID whose shared settings should apply.

mark_finished_if_click.description: Finish a contact after an email link click.

mark_finished_if_reply.description: Finish a contact after an email reply.

create_task_if_email_open.description: Create a task after the email-open threshold.

sequence_by_exact_daytime.description: When true, every step uses exact_datetime instead of relative wait fields.

excluded_account_stage_ids.description: Account-stage IDs excluded from the sequence.

excluded_contact_stage_ids.description: Contact-stage IDs excluded from the sequence.

mark_finished_if_interested.description: Finish a contact when marked interested.

same_account_reply_delay_days.description: Days to pause other contacts at the same account after a reply.

email_open_trigger_task_threshold.description: Email opens that trigger task creation.

days_to_wait_before_mark_as_response.description: Days after which an incoming email is no longer a sequence response.

ignore_apollo_global_email_bounce_list.description: When true, send to contacts on Apollo's global bounce list.

conversations.export.title: Export Conversations
conversations.export.description: Start an asynchronous gzipped JSON conversation export and email a team member when it is ready. Apollo charges 1 conversation credit for each exported conversation that has AI insights.

start_time.description: Start of the export range as an ISO-8601 GMT timestamp.

end_time.description: End of the export range as an ISO-8601 GMT timestamp. Must be later than start_time.

email.description: Email address of a valid Apollo team member to notify.

conversations.get.title: Get Conversation
conversations.get.description: Retrieve full Apollo conversation details, including transcript, participants, and recordings. Apollo charges one conversation credit when AI insights are present.

conversation_id.description: Apollo conversation ID. A shared conversation can use the id_shareid format.

conversations.get_export.title: Get Conversation Export
conversations.get_export.description: Retrieve the download URL for a previously started Apollo conversation export.

emails.get_activities.title: Get Email Activities
emails.get_activities.description: Retrieve content, open and click activity, and recipient details for one Apollo sequence email. Requires a master API key.

email_id.description: Apollo ID of the sequence email to inspect.

emails.get_content.title: Get Email Content
emails.get_content.description: Retrieve subject, body, and recipients for up to 10 sent team outreach emails. Drafted, scheduled, failed, and inbound emails are omitted.

ids.description: Apollo IDs of sent outreach emails. Apollo uses only the first 10 IDs.

labels.list.title: Get Labels
labels.list.description: List Apollo contact and account lists (labels) used to organize records.

deals.list_stages.title: List Deal Stages
deals.list_stages.description: List opportunity (deal) stages configured for the Apollo team.

organizations.get.title: Get Organization
organizations.get.description: Retrieve complete Apollo organization information by organization ID, including funding, technologies, and employee counts.

custom_fields.list.title: List Typed Custom Fields
custom_fields.list.description: List typed custom field definitions for the Apollo team, including types and picklist configuration.

account_stages.list.title: List Account Stages
account_stages.list.description: List account stage IDs and names for the Apollo team.

contact_stages.list.title: List Contact Stages
contact_stages.list.description: List contact stage IDs and names for the Apollo team.

fields.list.title: List Fields
fields.list.description: List Apollo field definitions, including system, custom, and CRM-synced fields.

notes.list.title: List Notes
notes.list.description: List notes on Apollo records. Supply at least one contact, account, opportunity, calendar-event, or conversation ID.

skip.description: Number of matching notes to skip. Apollo defaults to 0.

limit.description: Maximum notes to return, from 1 to 100. Apollo defaults to 25.

account_id.description: Account ID whose notes to retrieve.

contact_id.description: Contact ID whose notes to retrieve.

start_date.description: Return notes created on or after this YYYY-MM-DD date.

contact_ids.description: Contact IDs whose notes to retrieve.

opportunity_id.description: Opportunity ID whose notes to retrieve.

conversation_id.description: Conversation ID whose notes to retrieve.

conversation_ids.description: Conversation IDs whose notes to retrieve.

calendar_event_id.description: Calendar event ID whose notes to retrieve.

analytics.query.title: Query Analytics Report
analytics.query.description: Query Apollo analytics metrics, dimensions, filters, and date ranges. This endpoint costs zero credits.

metrics.description: Metrics to query. An empty list returns no metric columns.

smart_datetime_reference.description: Date column used for this metric, for example activity_datetime.

smart_user_id_reference.description: User column used for this metric, for example user_id.

group_by.description: Zero or one row dimension. Use an empty list for flat totals.

limit.description: Maximum number of dimension values to return.

sorts.description: Zero or one metric sort. Apollo applies only the first sort.

asc.description: Sort ascending when true, descending when false.

smart_datetime_reference.description: Date column for the sort metric.

smart_user_id_reference.description: User column for the sort metric.

filters.description: Analytics filters. Known keys are listed; additional dimension keys are accepted.

smart_user_id.description: Team member IDs, or current for the authenticated user.

smart_datetime_range.description: Custom date window used when modality is custom_range.

date_ranges.description: Zero or one preset date window.

pivot_group_by.description: Optional zero or one column dimension for a pivot cross-tab.

limit.description: Maximum number of dimension values to return.

skip_group_by_values.description: Raw group keys to exclude, up to 500 values.

min_ratio_denominator.description: Exclude ratio calculations whose denominator is below this threshold.

group_by_totals_selected.description: Include an aggregated totals row for the group dimension.

pivot_group_by_totals_selected.description: Include an aggregated totals column for the pivot dimension.

calls.search.title: Search Calls
calls.search.description: Search Apollo dialer call records by date, duration, direction, users, contacts, purposes, outcomes, and keywords.

user_ids.description: Apollo user IDs that participated in the call.

q_keywords.description: Keywords to match against call records.

contact_label_ids.description: Contact list IDs associated with the calls.

conversations.search.title: Search Conversations
conversations.search.description: Search Apollo video meetings and dialer calls using record, participant, date, scorecard, sorting, and visibility filters. Results include summaries, not transcripts.

num_fetch_result.description: Maximum number of conversation results to request.

tag_ids.description: Label or tag IDs applied to the conversations.

account_id.description: Apollo account ID associated with the conversations.

start.description: Inclusive start time in ISO-8601 GMT.

end.description: Inclusive end time in ISO-8601 GMT.

contact_ids.description: Apollo contact IDs associated with the conversations.

tracker_ids.description: Apollo tracker IDs associated with the conversations.

sort_by_field.description: Conversation field used to sort results.

organization_ids.description: Apollo organization IDs associated with the conversations.

conversation_type.description: Restrict results to video conferences or dialer calls.

scorecard_max_rating.description: Maximum scorecard rating included in the results.

scorecard_template_id.description: Scorecard template ID used to filter conversations.

enforce_contact_boundary.description: Restrict results to conversations visible to the specified contacts.

news.search.title: Search News Articles
news.search.description: Search Apollo news articles about companies using organization IDs, categories, and publication dates.

categories.description: News categories or sub-categories, for example hires or investment.

emails.search.title: Search Outreach Emails
emails.search.description: Search emails created and sent as part of Apollo sequences. Display is limited to 50,000 records.

user_ids.description: Apollo user IDs that sent the emails.

q_keywords.description: Keywords to match against outreach emails.

emails.send_now.title: Send Email Now
emails.send_now.description: Queue an existing drafted, scheduled, or failed Apollo email for immediate sending. A 200 response means queued, not delivered.

id.description: Apollo email message ID to send.

surface.description: Optional Apollo surface used for send attribution.

accounts.update_owners.title: Update Account Owners
accounts.update_owners.description: Assign the same Apollo user as owner of multiple accounts.

owner_id.description: Apollo user ID to assign as owner.

calls.update.title: Update Call Record
calls.update.description: Update an existing Apollo call record, including duration, status, notes, and associated contact or account.

id.description: Apollo call record ID to update.

logged.description: When true, keep an individual Apollo phone-call record.

user_id.description: Apollo user IDs for the caller.

duration.description: Call duration in seconds, not minutes.

end_time.description: Call end time in ISO-8601 GMT.

start_time.description: Call start time in ISO-8601 GMT.

contacts.update_owners.title: Update Contact Owners
contacts.update_owners.description: Assign the same Apollo user as owner of multiple contacts. The user must belong to the same team.

owner_id.description: Apollo user ID to assign as owner.

contacts.bulk_update.title: Bulk Update Contacts
contacts.bulk_update.description: Update multiple Apollo contacts in one request. Provide contact_ids to apply the same values, or contact_attributes for per-contact updates. Requests over 100 contacts process asynchronously.

async.description: Force asynchronous processing. Automatically enabled for more than 100 contacts.

email.description: Email applied to every contact_ids entry.

title.description: Title applied to every contact_ids entry.

owner_id.description: Owner ID applied to every contact_ids entry.

last_name.description: Last name applied to every contact_ids entry.

account_id.description: Account ID applied to every contact_ids entry.

first_name.description: First name applied to every contact_ids entry.

contact_ids.description: Contact IDs that receive the same updates.

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn URL applied to every contact_ids entry.

organization_name.description: Organization name applied to every contact_ids entry.

contact_attributes.description: Per-contact updates. Provide this or contact_ids.

typed_custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field ID.

visible_entity_ids.description: Optional contact IDs to include in the response.

present_raw_address.description: Address applied to every contact_ids entry.

typed_custom_fields.description: Custom fields applied to every contact_ids entry.

sequences.update_contact_status.title: Update Contact Status in Sequence
sequences.update_contact_status.description: Mark contacts finished in a sequence, remove them, or stop their progress. Apollo cannot set status to active through this endpoint.

contact_ids.description: Apollo contact IDs whose sequence status should change.

sequences.update.title: Update Sequence
sequences.update.description: Update an Apollo sequence's settings, ownership, sharing, steps, and touches. Supplying emailer_steps replaces the ordered step set.

active.description: Turn the sequence on or off.

user_id.description: Apollo user ID of the sequence's new owner.

cc_emails.description: Comma-separated CC addresses for sequence emails.

bcc_emails.description: Comma-separated BCC addresses for sequence emails.

label_names.description: Replacement list of labels or folders.

emailer_steps.description: Complete ordered step list. Omitted existing steps are removed.

id.description: Existing step ID when updating a sequence.

wait_time.description: Wait amount after the previous step.

exact_datetime.description: Exact ISO-8601 datetime when sequence_by_exact_daytime is true.

auto_skip_in_x_days.description: Skip the step task after this many days.

emailer_touches.description: Email or task variants for the step.

items.description: Email or task variant for a sequence step.

status.description: Touch approval status, for example approved.
